items: Mix yeast, water, and sugar; set aside.
Measure flour and salt to mixing bowl. Add yeast mixture.
Roll into rectangle and cut into strips widthwise.
Melt 1 cube butter (or margarine) and pour onto a large cookie sheet.
Roll dough strips in margarine (or butter). Roll dough strips in butter and place side by side on baking sheet.
Sprinkle with garlic salt, Italian seasoning and Parmesan cheese.
Can be sprinkled with cinnamon and sugar for a sweet taste.
